what_it_does: Proposes E-DOSA, a data flow architecture for accelerating spiking neural networks (brain-inspired artificial neurons that communicate via discrete spike events rather than continuous activations). Addresses the unique challenges of SNNs which process information across time steps and exhibit sparsity patterns different from traditional neural networks. The design uses a 2D grid of processing elements (compute units) arranged in rows and columns working together to reuse data efficiently.
